newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says will act against excessive forex moves.
newsitem.headline: MOF says will act against excessive forex moves.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Friday that his ministry would take appropriate steps against excessive movements in the foreign exchange market.

Asked about recent movements in the foreign exchange market and whether Japan would intervene, Mitsuzuka said that it was important for the world and Japanese economies for foreign exchange rates to be stable.
He said excessive yen weakening or strengthening were both undesirable.
"We will take appropriate measures against excessive moves (in exchange rates). This was also agreed at the meeting of Group of Seven nations in Berlin in February."
"The level (of yen weakness) up to yesterday was excessive," he said.
Asked whether he considered the current level also excessively weak, he replied: "It is an excessive yen weakness so we will take drastic measures at an appropriate time."
